name: portfolio-showcase
context: Design a portfolio showcase page for creative professionals (designers, developers, photographers). The audience is potential clients and recruiters viewing project work. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and mobile responsive. The layout must emphasize visual work with minimal UI chrome, smooth transitions between project previews, and elegant typography.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Typography must follow typography.rules.json with emphasis on display/heading scale for project titles
Color usage minimal and restrained per color.rules.json to let portfolio content shine
Layout must use full-width or wide-grid options from layout.rules.json
Motion presets must enhance browsing without distracting from content
Assets (project thumbnails) referenced via Design_Asset_Package IDs
Comply with Quality_Gate: visual hierarchy guides eye to work samples, proper semantic structure
If the brief explicitly requests closing footage, preserve it as the footer's single ambient system with poster, responsive focal crop, reduced-motion still, and readable scrim
Build a private brief-fidelity ledger and preserve every safe supplied URL, dependency, named content job, interaction, and literal with concrete source evidence

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with project grid, project detail overlay, and navigation using token references
qualityChecks: Project grid uses consistent spacing from Token_System
Typography scale creates clear hierarchy between project titles and metadata
Transitions between states use Motion_Library presets
Color palette is restrained, using surface and text tokens primarily
No raw visual values in the output
Explicitly requested cinematic closing footage is present and remains visibly legible
Every safe item in the brief-fidelity ledger has concrete source evidence
accessibilityRequirements: All project images have descriptive alt text summarizing the work
Navigation between projects is keyboard accessible
Modal/overlay project details can be dismissed with Escape key
Focus is trapped within open overlay and restored on close
Sufficient contrast maintained even with minimal color palette

examples.description: Project showcase grid with hover reveal and modal detail view
examples.output:
Organism: ProjectGrid
  Layout: grid(columns: 2 @tablet, 3 @desktop, 1 @mobile, gap: var(--space-lg))
  Children:
    - Molecule: ProjectCard
        position: relative
        radius: var(--radius-md)
        overflow: hidden
        Children:
          - Atom: Image(aspectRatio=16/9, alt='{project.title} - {project.category}')
          - Container: Overlay(opacity: 0 -> 1 on hover)
              bg: var(--color-surface-overlay)
              padding: var(--space-md)
              motion: hover-focus.fade-in
              - Atom: Text(token=typography.heading.md, color=color.text-on-dark)
              - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text-on-dark-secondary)
        States:
          hover: overlay visible, scale(1.02) via state-transition
          focus-within: outline(var(--color-focus-ring)), overlay visible
        Interaction: click/Enter opens ProjectDetailModal
acceptanceCriteria: Hover and focus states both reveal project info (not hover-only)
All motion uses declared Motion_Library presets
Image alt text includes project context
Token references used for all spacing, color, and typography
